title: Native approval
responsibility: Approves a sign-in request from a Harness device using a separately typed one-time code.

inputs.name: NativeApproval.handoffId
inputs.description: Required identifier used to read the native request and approve it. Loading occurs on mount; prop changes alone do not reload.

outputs.name: NativeApproval
outputs.description: Names the account and requested projects, explains role-limited viewing, comments and agent changes, and accepts a device code in a POST body. Never puts the code or credential in a link.
